Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • New mail at the notch (experimental). Turn on Show new mail at the notch in Settings › General › Notifications. New mail then drops down from the top of the screen instead of showing as a macOS notification. It shows the sender, subject and a preview, and any sign-in code is one click to copy. Click the message to open it. It slides away after a few seconds, or stays while your pointer is over it. Use Try It to see a sample.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Escape closes the message you're writing. If there's anything in it, you're asked whether to keep the draft.
  • Paste files and screenshots. Pressing ⌘V on files copied in Finder, or on a screenshot copied to the clipboard, now adds them as attachments.
  • ⌘Z undoes more. Deleting a single message from a conversation and adding or removing a label can now be undone.

Bug fixes

  • Very long names no longer run past the edge of the To and Cc fields. They end in "…" instead.
  • In the search field or the reply box, ⌘Z now undoes your typing instead of your last archive or delete.
  • If your name contains a comma, it's now formatted correctly when you send.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • In "What's New", Show earlier updates is now a full-width button that's easy to click. Before, only a tiny arrow responded.
